item.tib: bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi zhu lan
item.coloph: de ltar rmi lam 'khrul snang 'di/ dad ldan grogs po rnams kyis bskul nas su/ dkar chag yi ge ris su btab pa 'di/ bla ma mkha' 'gro rnams la bzod par gsol/ 'di bris dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ pha mas gtsor byas sems can rnams/ bon nyid dbyings su sangs rgyas shog/
